button.name: Kickass Homebrew
button.author: vibecoderanon
button.description: A premium proof-of-concept Switch homebrew application featuring a wavy 90s WordArt splash screen, strobe light utility, automated Picross solver, and an optimized Sudoku solver using the Minimum Remaining Values (MRV) heuristic. Includes a secret easter egg screen hidden for you to discover! Developed in Lua using LÖVE Potion.
